Scharf Investments LLC Position in Cdk Global INC (CDK) Increased by $51.35 Million
August 25, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Scharf Investments Llc increased its stake in Cdk Global Inc (CDK) by 50.14% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Scharf Investments Llc bought 815,115 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.48% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.44 million shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $154.61 million, up from 1.63 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Scharf Investments Llc who had been investing in Cdk Global Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.93B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.03% or $0.02 $61.23. About 657,118 shares traded. CDK Global, Inc. (NASDAQ:CDK) has risen 4.20% uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.37% the S&P500.
Scharf Investments Llc, which manages about $2.69 billion and $3.56B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 473,379 shares to 496,872 shares, valued at $83.37 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Schlumberger Ltd (NYSE:SLB) by 1.46M shares in the quarter, leaving it with 10,373 shares, and cut its stake in Sherwin Williams Co (NYSE:SHW).
